$schema: Notesage workflow viewer data — see docs/workflows.html

flows.title: Save a file (Cmd+S)
flows.summary: Persists the active document to disk, suppresses the resulting watcher event, and triggers a SQLite reindex of the changed file.

steps.label: serialize doc
steps.detail: ProseMirror doc → markdown via prosemirror-markdown serializer in src/lib/markdown.ts

steps.label: saveFile(path, text)
steps.detail: useFileOperations.saveFile() called from editor's Cmd+S handler

steps.label: invoke('mark_self_write')
steps.detail: Records the path in WatcherState.self_writes with a 5s TTL so the upcoming watcher event is suppressed

steps.label: invoke('write_file')
steps.detail: After mark_self_write resolves; writes UTF-8 bytes

steps.label: write_file(path, content)
steps.detail: commands/file.rs writes the file via std::fs

steps.label: fs::write
steps.detail: Real disk write; macOS FSEvents queues a Modify event

steps.label: FSEvents → notify
steps.detail: notify_debouncer_full coalesces within 500ms; classified as Modify

steps.label: queue reindex
steps.detail: Self-writes are still indexed (only the frontend file-changed-batch event is suppressed)

steps.label: (suppressed)
steps.detail: is_self_write() returns true so no file-changed-batch event fires for this path

steps.label: mark tab clean
steps.detail: editor-store.markClean(tabId); savedAt timestamp updated, 'saved Xs ago' chrome refreshes

flows.title: Open a file from the sidebar
flows.summary: Loads file contents from disk, parses markdown into a ProseMirror doc, and either creates or activates a tab.

steps.label: click row
steps.detail: FileTreeItem onActivate → useFileOperations.openFile(path)

steps.label: lookup tab
steps.detail: editor-store.openDocuments scanned for existing tab; if found, just activate

steps.label: invoke('read_file')
steps.detail: Only invoked on cache miss; routes by extension (markdown vs binary viewer)

steps.label: read_file(path)
steps.detail: commands/file.rs returns Ok(String) for UTF-8, Err otherwise

steps.label: fs::read_to_string
steps.detail: Reads bytes; cloud paths gated by 10s per-step timeout in startup wrapper

steps.label: addTab + setActive
steps.detail: editor-store.openDocuments updated with new entry; activeTabId set

steps.label: render active tab
steps.detail: Editor.tsx subscribes to activeTabId; effect triggers content load

steps.label: loadRawMarkdownIntoEditor
steps.detail: Parses markdown → ProseMirror doc; logs [perf:doc-load] and [perf:setContent]

flows.title: Open project + restore tabs (startup)
flows.summary: App boot flow: validates persisted workspace state, refreshes file trees, restores open tabs, initializes the SQLite index, and starts watchers.

steps.label: App mount → useAppLifecycle
steps.detail: Single 30s global timeout + 10s per-step timeouts so cloud paths can't hang startup

steps.label: rehydrate Zustand
steps.detail: workspace · editor · settings · ai · routing · permission stores load from localStorage

steps.label: list_directory(project)
steps.detail: One call per project root; show_hidden honoured by settings.showHiddenFiles

steps.label: list_directory recursive
steps.detail: Returns FileEntry[] with hidden flag; .DS_Store and .git internals always excluded

steps.label: scan dir tree
steps.detail: Walks the workspace; ancestor stat needed for fs.watch parent traversal

steps.label: init_index(project)
steps.detail: src/index/mod.rs ensures index.db exists; iCloud-excluded via xattr

steps.label: open / migrate db
steps.detail: Per-project ~/.notesage/index.db schema check + comrak walk for changed files

steps.label: watch_directory(...)
steps.detail: Once per project root; deduped against WatcherState.watched_paths

steps.label: notify watcher start
steps.detail: Lazy-init RecommendedWatcher with 500ms debounce

steps.label: restore active tab
steps.detail: editor-store.activeTabId reapplied; loadRawMarkdownIntoEditor for first paint

steps.label: set startupReady
steps.detail: settings.startupReady=true releases the watcher gate; tray sync begins

flows.title: External file change → diff review
flows.summary: A file changes outside Notesage (other editor, AI agent, terminal). Watcher fires, the frontend either silently reloads or surfaces an inline diff for review.

steps.label: FSEvents change
steps.detail: Real change hits notify; not in self_writes set

steps.label: queue reindex
steps.detail: All real changes feed the reindex queue regardless of frontend gating

steps.label: emit file-changed-batch
steps.detail: Batched per debounce window: [{ path, kind: 'create'|'modify'|'delete' }]

steps.label: useFileWatcher event
steps.detail: Reads file, compares to in-memory tab; bails if identical (content guard)

steps.label: branch on setting
steps.detail: settings.externalChangeDiffReview decides: silent reload (off) vs review (on)

steps.label: OFF: setContent
steps.detail: Auto-reload via editor.commands.setContent + 3s info toast (toastExternalReload)

steps.label: ON: inline diff
steps.detail: external-change-store.addChange() drives the InlineDiff plugin; per-hunk accept/reject

steps.label: sticky action toast
steps.detail: toastExternalChange with Accept / Reject / Dismiss; Reject re-saves to avoid re-detection loop

flows.title: Send a chat message (direct API: Anthropic / OpenAI / Ollama)
flows.summary: Streaming SSE chat to a hosted or local API. Tokens flow back as Tauri events; segments dual-write into the chat store.

steps.label: send + attachments
steps.detail: ChatInput → useDirectApiChat.send(); images compressed via image-compress.ts

steps.label: addMessage(user)
steps.detail: chat-store appends user message; tool definitions resolved from skill-store.getToolDefinitions()

steps.label: invoke('ai_chat_stream')
steps.detail: Args include connection_id (NOT the API key) + tools array + scope

steps.label: resolve key by id
steps.detail: ai_streaming.rs reads the API key from OS keychain via keyring crate

steps.label: secret string
steps.detail: Key never returns to the frontend

steps.label: POST stream
steps.detail: Anthropic /v1/messages, OpenAI /v1/responses, or Ollama /api/chat (with runtime thinking detection via /api/show)

steps.label: SSE chunks
steps.detail: Provider-specific framing parsed; thinking, text, tool_use, image blocks

steps.label: emit ai-stream-*
steps.detail: ai-stream-chunk · ai-stream-thinking-chunk · ai-tool-call · ai-stream-image · ai-stream-done

steps.label: stream listeners
steps.detail: useDirectApiChat throttles to 50ms flushes; appends segments + content (dual write)

steps.label: appendTextSegment / pushSegment
steps.detail: chat-store actions; conv.updatedAt bumped to invalidate selectors

steps.label: render segments
steps.detail: SegmentRenderer → Text/Thinking/ToolCall/ToolResult/Image segment views

flows.title: Send a chat message (ACP agent: Claude Code / Codex / Copilot CLI / Gemini)
flows.summary: JSON-RPC over stdio to a managed agent subprocess running under Seatbelt. Tool calls require permission cards; updates stream as session events.

steps.label: send
steps.detail: useAcpLifecycle ensures a session via restoreOrCreateAcpSession (resume → load → list → new)

steps.label: invoke('acp_session_prompt')
steps.detail: Includes session_id, content blocks (text + image), and any locked project paths

steps.label: session/prompt
steps.detail: agent-client-protocol crate marshals to JSON-RPC; writes to subprocess stdin

steps.label: (spawn-time gate)
steps.detail: First spawn loaded a Seatbelt profile from getChatSandboxScope: writable=selected projects, deny default network

steps.label: stdin write
steps.detail: Agent runs inside Seatbelt; only allowed network is localhost:proxy_port

steps.label: HTTP via proxy
steps.detail: All outbound HTTP forced through the localhost proxy by HTTP_PROXY env + kernel deny-default

steps.label: allowlisted domain
steps.detail: Built-in defaults per provider + user-configurable additions; unknown domains trigger approval card

steps.label: session/update
steps.detail: agent_message_chunk · agent_thought_chunk · tool_call · tool_call_update · plan · usage_update

steps.label: emit acp-session-update
steps.detail: AcpClient impl forwards every notification to the frontend

steps.label: useAcpSessionListeners
steps.detail: Normalizes ToolCallContent (Diff/Content/Terminal) via acp-utils.normalizeToolCallContent

steps.label: dual-write segments
steps.detail: chat-store + activity-store updated; tool calls become ToolCallSegment + AgentActivity

steps.label: task pulse / orb
steps.detail: AgentOrb count badge + CSS keyframe pulse; click opens AgentPanel popover

flows.title: AI tool call execution (e.g., write_file)
flows.summary: Mid-stream the model requests a tool. Permission card surfaces for write/execute tools, then the executor runs the tool, scope-gates the path, and feeds the result back into the next API turn.

steps.label: emit ai-tool-call
steps.detail: Payload: { id, name, arguments } parsed from provider-specific tool_use blocks

steps.label: useDirectApiChat hears event
steps.detail: Routes to tool-executor.ts for client-side execution

steps.label: permission check
steps.detail: Auto-allow for read tools; permission-store.toolCallAlways scoped by (toolName, connectionId, projectRoot)

steps.label: render permission card
steps.detail: ToolCallPermissionCard for non-auto tools; tiered allow once/session/always; 30s auto-deny

steps.label: isToolCallAllowed
steps.detail: src/lib/tool-executor.ts gates FS tools on path scope (selectProjectPaths(chat-store))

steps.label: invoke('write_file')
steps.detail: Or read_file / list_directory / web_search / execute_skill_script depending on tool

steps.label: execute
steps.detail: Backend command runs; result string returned

steps.label: fs op
steps.detail: Real disk write; will trigger save-file flow's watcher path next

steps.label: push ToolResultSegment
steps.detail: chat-store appends the result; activity-store records approvalMode (auto/user/denied)

steps.label: ai_chat_stream (continue)
steps.detail: Result fed back as role:'tool' message; loop caps at 20 calls per turn

flows.title: Inline completion (Copilot LSP ghost text)
flows.summary: Editor changes are mirrored to the Copilot Language Server over JSON-RPC; suggestions render as ghost-text widget decorations.

steps.label: doc transaction
steps.detail: Tiptap update event fires on every edit

steps.label: useCopilotCompletion debounce
steps.detail: 150ms debounce; uses ProseMirror plain-text projection of the doc

steps.label: isUriInScope check
steps.detail: src/lib/ai/uri-scope.ts gates on chat-footer-selected project roots; out-of-scope tabs skipped

steps.label: invoke copilot/textDocument/didChange
steps.detail: Full content replacement; followed by textDocument/inlineCompletion at cursor

steps.label: JSON-RPC request
steps.detail: copilot_protocol.rs handles Content-Length framing + pending request map

steps.label: stdin → copilot-language-server
steps.detail: Spawned from agent-manager; subscription auth via OAuth device flow

steps.label: Copilot completion API
steps.detail: Provider-side completion call; response returned to LSP

steps.label: JSON-RPC response
steps.detail: Reader loop matches request id → resolves pending promise

steps.label: completion text
steps.detail: Returned as Tauri command result

steps.label: setGhostText
steps.detail: GhostText extension dispatches a transaction with widget decoration at cursor

steps.label: render ghost
steps.detail: Tab to accept · Esc to dismiss · any keystroke auto-clears

flows.title: Comment delegation to AI agent
flows.summary: User creates a comment with text selected, then delegates to the agent_tasks-routed connection. Agent reply renders inside the comment thread with optional 'Apply' inline diff.

steps.label: Cmd+Shift+M
steps.detail: CommentMark extension applied to selection; anchor positions persisted via PM mapping

steps.label: comment-store.add
steps.detail: Project files: keyed by frontmatter UUID. Non-project: path-hashed sidecar in ~/.notesage/comments/

steps.label: write comment sidecar
steps.detail: JSON file in .notesage/comments/{uuid}.json or path-{hash}.json

steps.label: Delegate clicked
steps.detail: useCommentDelegation → useAgentTaskOperations.startTask() with anchor text + prompt

steps.label: activity-store.start
steps.detail: AgentActivity recorded with kind:'task'; orb pulses, panel shows running entry

steps.label: invoke('acp_session_prompt')
steps.detail: Routed via routing-store.agent_tasks slot; restoreOrCreateAcpSession used

steps.label: session/prompt
steps.detail: Same path as send-acp; session resilience via acp_is_agent_alive timer (5min)

steps.label: agent runs
steps.detail: Tool calls scope-gated via path-filter.ts (auto-allow AND user-approve paths)

steps.label: session updates
steps.detail: Reply text accumulates as a threaded reply on the comment

steps.label: useAcpSessionListeners
steps.detail: Updates threaded reply on the comment; existingTaskId reused for multi-turn

steps.label: Apply → AISuggestion
steps.detail: Applies inline diff to anchor text; preamble stripped; Cmd+Enter accept / Cmd+Backspace reject

flows.title: Skill discovery + script execution
flows.summary: Skills are discovered from on-disk SKILL.md files, surfaced to the model as tool definitions, and (when called) executed as sandboxed scripts.

steps.label: useSkillOperations
steps.detail: Runs at startup AND on watcher event; logs [perf:skills]

steps.label: invoke('discover_skills')
steps.detail: Scope: ~/.notesage/skills/ (global) + selected projects' .notesage/skills/

steps.label: scan + parse
steps.detail: skills.rs walks dirs; skills_frontmatter.rs parses YAML; skills_tool_parser.rs extracts tool defs

steps.label: read SKILL.md
steps.detail: Project skills override global; auto-extracts bundled skills on first run

steps.label: Skill[]
steps.detail: Returned to frontend with byProject + global registry shape

steps.label: skill-store update
steps.detail: { global, byProject } merged at send time by selectedProjectPaths

steps.label: tools[] in prompt
steps.detail: skill-store.getToolDefinitions() called; agent's allowed-tools filters the set

steps.label: emit ai-tool-call
steps.detail: Tool name follows skill__{skill}__{script} convention

steps.label: permission card
steps.detail: permission-store.skillScriptAlways scoped by (toolName, connectionId, projectRoot)

steps.label: invoke('execute_skill_script')
steps.detail: Args resolved from ArgMapping (frontmatter or Usage: comment fallback)

steps.label: spawn interpreter
steps.detail: script_exec.rs resolves bash/python/node via shell_path.rs PATH; runs under Seatbelt scope

steps.label: subprocess
steps.detail: Sandbox writable = chat scope; network = proxy-only

flows.title: Export PDF
flows.summary: Markdown → Typst markup → embedded Typst compiler → PDF bytes → native save dialog → disk write.

steps.label: ExportDialog confirm
steps.detail: Cmd+Shift+E or sidebar 'Export as PDF'; useExportOperations.exportPdf()

steps.label: read settings
steps.detail: Template (clean/academic/report), TOC, page numbers, page size persisted

steps.label: invoke('export_pdf')
steps.detail: Args include the in-memory markdown (NOT just the path) so unsaved edits export

steps.label: markdown_to_typst
steps.detail: comrak GFM walk → Typst markup; tables, drawings, link previews handled

steps.label: resolve drawing svgs
steps.detail: project_root used to find .excalidraw → .svg sidecars

steps.label: Typst compile
steps.detail: NotesageWorld trait impl + bundled fonts (Inter/Source Serif 4/JetBrains Mono); typst_pdf::pdf()

steps.label: Vec<u8> bytes
steps.detail: PDF bytes returned to the frontend

steps.label: open save dialog
steps.detail: tauri-plugin-dialog save; default filename from doc title

steps.label: save_binary_file
steps.detail: Writes raw bytes (write_file is UTF-8 only); offers 'Reveal in Finder' toast action

steps.label: fs::write bytes
steps.detail: PDF lands at the chosen path

flows.title: Voice transcription (record → Whisper → insert)
flows.summary: cpal captures audio, resamples to 16kHz mono, whisper-rs runs locally, and segments are inserted at the cursor.

steps.label: Cmd+Shift+R
steps.detail: useRecording.toggle(); shows recording indicator

steps.label: invoke('start_recording')
steps.detail: Source: 'microphone'; spawns dedicated thread (cpal Stream is !Send)

steps.label: cpal stream start
steps.detail: Captures at device-native sample rate / channel count

steps.label: Cmd+Shift+R again
steps.detail: User stops recording

steps.label: invoke('stop_recording')
steps.detail: Returns AudioBufferInfo (duration, samples, rate)

steps.label: buffer ready
steps.detail: Resamples to 16kHz mono in transcription state

steps.label: invoke('transcribe', model)
steps.detail: Auto-downloads base model if none present

steps.label: whisper-rs run
steps.detail: Metal GPU acceleration on macOS; emits transcription-progress events

steps.label: TranscriptionResult
steps.detail: Segments with start/end timestamps + detected language

steps.label: insert segments
steps.detail: Concatenated text inserted at cursor via PM transaction

flows.title: Domain approval (sandbox + proxy + user)
flows.summary: An ACP agent makes an HTTP request to a domain not on the allowlist. The proxy queues it and asks the user via a chat card; the kernel sandbox guarantees the agent can't bypass the proxy.

steps.label: outbound TCP
steps.detail: Seatbelt: (deny default) for network; only localhost:proxy_port allowed

steps.label: kernel-routed
steps.detail: Agent literally cannot reach anywhere else; HTTP_PROXY env points at the localhost port

steps.label: domain check
steps.detail: permission-store.alwaysAllowedDomains scoped by (connectionId, projectRoot|'global')

steps.label: emit domain-approval-request
steps.detail: Sent on cache miss; carries instance_id + domain

steps.label: DomainApprovalCard
steps.detail: Allow once / for session / always · Deny · 30s auto-deny timeout

steps.label: store decision
steps.detail: Always-allow persisted; session-allow held in memory; once-allow consumed

steps.label: approve / deny
steps.detail: invoke('approve_domain' / 'deny_domain') with the request id

steps.label: release / drop
steps.detail: Approved: proxies to ai-apis. Denied/timeout: 403 to agent + chat message

steps.label: violation entries
steps.detail: sandbox_monitor.rs streams `log stream` for Seatbelt deny lines; rendered in Activity panel

flows.title: Image attachment in chat (paste → compress → vision)
flows.summary: Image enters via paste, drag, file picker, or 'Add to chat' from the editor. Client-side compression keeps payload small; vision capability is checked per provider.

steps.label: vision event bus
steps.detail: Right-click 'Add to chat' on editor image / drawing → src/lib/ai/vision.ts dispatches event

steps.label: drag image file
steps.detail: Or 'Add to chat' from sidebar context menu on image files

steps.label: addAttachment(file)
steps.detail: Up to 5 attachments per message; AttachmentStrip thumbnails appear

steps.label: image-compress.ts
steps.detail: Canvas API: resize to 1568px max, PNG→JPEG, 5MB cap

steps.label: vision capability
steps.detail: Anthropic/OpenAI: always. Ollama: /api/show probe. Local: catalog supports_vision. ACP: promptCapabilities.images

steps.label: (switch model?)
steps.detail: Switching to a non-vision model clears pending attachments

steps.label: ai_chat_stream + images
steps.detail: Per-provider serialization — Anthropic base64 blocks, OpenAI image_url, Ollama images[] field

steps.label: format payload
steps.detail: ai_streaming.rs picks the right shape per provider

steps.label: POST with images
steps.detail: Stream resumes as in send-direct-api flow

flows.title: Agent binary install (managed install wizard)
flows.summary: On first connection, the agent binary is downloaded from GitHub Releases into ~/.notesage/agents/bin/. Updates ride the same path.

steps.label: Add Connection
steps.detail: Settings → Connections → agent-managed provider; install wizard opens

steps.label: invoke('install_agent')
steps.detail: agent_manager.rs picks the right asset for the current platform

steps.label: begin install
steps.detail: Looks up version manifest; deduplicates against current installed version

steps.label: download asset
steps.detail: GitHub Releases zip/tar; chunked download with progress events

steps.label: emit install-progress
steps.detail: Frontend shows progress bar in the wizard

steps.label: extract to bin
steps.detail: ~/.notesage/agents/bin/<agent>; chmod +x; symlink-resolution friendly

steps.label: invoke('acp_register_connection')
steps.detail: Capability probe spawns the agent briefly to discover modes / config / capabilities

steps.label: spawn → initialize
steps.detail: ACP initialize handshake; AuthMethod list returned

steps.label: stdio JSON-RPC
steps.detail: If EnvVar auth: surface generic credential form. If OAuth: open browser via run_in_terminal

steps.label: capabilities
steps.detail: Stored on connection; auto-refreshed when stale (>24h)

steps.label: connections-store
steps.detail: Connection added; routing-store auto-fills compatible use-case slots
